svg.title: The KnobShift player at work
svg.desc: A song plays with its progress moving. In the queue, a Spotify playlist downloads song by song and new songs are prepared one by one, each ring filling until the song is ready with its tempo. KnobMix Now is pressed, waits for the next phrase, and the player mixes into the next song, which starts at its verse.

g.text: Seamless mixes for the music on your Mac
